This small piece of land, just my little plot near the house, I plant my yam and cassava like my mother taught me. I have no money for the fertilizer from the bag — those things cost too much for such a small piece, and one bag is more than my plot can take anyway. I will put the goat droppings and the ash from my cooking fire, that one I always do. The vines and yam setts I keep from last year's harvest, that is what I plant, same as everybody here.
